data.name: Tower! Simulator 3
data.detailed_description:
New Voices & Speech Recognition - Gamechanger

New Neural AI Pilot Voices

Tower Simulator 3 now features a new generation of pilot voices powered by Neural AI technology. Runs entirely on your PC. This update replaces the old voices.

No internet connection required

No subscriptions

No cloud processing

More natural and immersive radio communications.

If you find the radio background noise too strong, you can reduce it: Settings → Sounds → Speech Mode → Radio Low (Default is Radio High)

New Flexible AI Voice Recognition (Optional)

A brand-new Neural AI speech recognition engine has been added to the simulator. Just like the new voices:

Runs locally on your PC

No internet traffic

No data sharing

No subscriptions required

Important: The new recognizer is NOT enabled by default. Tower Simulator 3 will continue using the existing recognizer unless you choose to switch. To try the new system: Settings → Sounds → Recognizer Mode → Flexible AI


About the Game

Tower! Simulator 3 puts you in control of busy airports around the world, where every departure, arrival, runway crossing, and taxi instruction is your responsibility. Whether you’re managing a quiet regional airport or coordinating traffic at a major international hub, every decision matters.


Built for aviation enthusiasts, aspiring controllers, and industry professionals alike, Tower! Simulator 3 combines realistic airport operations, advanced voice communications, a fully interactive 3D tower environment, and extensive customization tools into the ultimate ATC experience.

Key Features

Voice-Controlled Air Traffic Control

Communicate with pilots using advanced voice recognition technology and experience realistic ATC interactions from the tower.

Realistic Airport Operations

Manage departures, arrivals, taxi movements, runway crossings, gate assignments, and ground traffic using authentic ATC procedures.

Immersive 3D Tower View

Watch aircraft operate from a fully rendered control tower environment while maintaining complete control of airport operations.

Multiplayer Support

Work together with other controllers in real-time and divide responsibilities across ground, tower, and departure operations.

11 Airports Included

Start your ATC career immediately with eleven detailed airports included in the base game, ranging from regional destinations to major international hubs.

  • TIST (Cyril E. King Airport)

  • KLGA (LaGuardia Airport)

  • KLAX (Los Angeles International Airport)

  • KRDU (Raleigh-Durham International Airport)

  • TXKF (L.F. Wade International Airport)

  • EDDS (Stuttgart Airport)

  • KBUR (Hollywood Burbank Airport)

  • VRMM (Velana International Airport)

  • VIDP (Indira Gandhi International Airport)

  • TNCM (St. Marteen, Princess Juliana Airport)

  • KTLH (Tallahassee International Airport)

Community Modding & Customization
Customize schedules, airlines, strips, liveries, terminals, and airport operations. Create your own content and expand the simulator through community-driven enhancements.

Dynamic Real-World Lighting
Experience realistic lighting powered by real-world parameters, delivering stunning day, night, and weather transitions.

Multi-Monitor Support
Expand your workspace and build the ATC setup that best fits your style.


Built for the Community
From free airport additions and gameplay improvements to expanded customization and upcoming AI-powered technologies, the simulator is constantly growing alongside its passionate community.

Whether you’re issuing your very first takeoff clearance or managing a busy international hub during peak traffic, Tower! Simulator 3 delivers an authentic and rewarding air traffic control experience unlike any other.

ATC Mode On.

data.short_description: The Gold Standard in Air Traffic Control Simulation Control aircraft at 11 included airports, issue voice commands, manage traffic, and work together in multiplayer in the most immersive air traffic control simulator available.
data.reviews:
“Tower Simulator 3 is one of those games that make you feel like you put in an honest day’s work. Challenging, fun and frustrating all at the same time.”
10 – Sky Blue Radio

“Bought the game expecting an air traffic control. What I got was: - Air traffic control - Workload management training - Situational awareness training - A lesson in how quickly tunnel vision develops - A surprisingly effective way to observe my own decision-making under pressure”
10 – Steam user

“I like this game a lot i have played this game for 30+ hours now. In the beginning i had some problems with the voice in the game but it didn't make a big problem with playing this game. I think the developpers are doing a great job in this game with the updates so its worthed to buy this game and try it to control the air”
10 – Controller

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS *: 64 bit Windows 8.1, Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: 3.5 Ghz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4GB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires keyboard and microphone / headset
